module: Main window of the editor's Dynamic Decals tool (painting decals on the vehicle). Loads its 33 submodules via M.dependencies (editor_api_dynamicDecals API, widgets, layerStack, inspector, brushes, gizmo, vehicleColorPalette, loadSave, layerTypes_*, etc.) and acts as a hub: submodules register with it through setup(tool) using registerSection, registerToolbarToolItem, registerToolbarActionItem, registerEditorOnUpdateFn and registerOnEditorGuiFn. Also exposes the public interface called by keyboard/mouse actions (applyDecal, undo/redo, changeDecalSize/Rotation, depth/normal locking, brush mode, path layer).
notes: The hooks onEditorGui, onEditorInitialized, onEditorActivated, etc. are commented out in the code ("DISABLED, SPAMS LOG, DEPENDENCIES NOT FOUND"): they are not exported by this module.

applyDecal(value) expects 1 on press and another value on release. Priority: mask editing (currentMaskEditingLayerUid), active path layer, brushStroke mode, otherwise a simple decal (also adds the color to the color history).
Sections with an order >= 1000 are placed in the "Advanced" section.
M.toolModes = {none = 0, decal = 1, brushStroke = 2, path = 3}; toolMode is decal initially. M.version = {1,1,0}. M.directoryPath = "/art/dynamicDecals/".
changeDecalSize/Rotation multiply the steps of the preferences dynamicDecalsTool.decalProperties.scaleStep and rotationStep (degrees converted to radians) by mod.

dependencies.desc: List of extensions loaded before this module.

doApiUpdate.desc: If true (default), the tool calls the API update every frame; can be changed via a debug checkbox.

applyDecal.desc: Public brush interface: places a decal, a path point, a brush stroke or a mask decal depending on the current mode.

changeDecalSize.desc: Enlarges or shrinks the current decal.

undo.desc: Undoes the last action of the dynamicDecals API, then refreshes the layers selected in editor.selection.dynamicDecalLayer.

redo.desc: Redoes the undone action and refreshes the selected layers.

dynamicDecals_onLayerUpdated.desc: API hook: when a layer is modified, copies its data into the inspector selection if it is displayed there.

layerUid.desc: Identifier of the modified layer (type inferred from code)

dynamicDecals_moveLayer.desc: API hook called when a layer is moved: refreshes the destination parent layer if it is selected.

lockDepth.desc: Locks or releases the decal projection depth.

lockSurfaceNormal.desc: Locks or releases the surface normal used for projection.

enableBrushStroke.desc: Enables/disables the brush stroke; on disabling, adds a stroke layer (api.addBrushStrokeLayer).

removeLastPathLayerPoint.desc: Removes the last point of the current path.

registerSection.desc: Registers a UI section (and optionally a dedicated window). Sections are sorted by order; those >= 1000 go into "Advanced".

guiFn.desc: Draw function, called with a guiId (both in the section and in the window)

window.desc: {windowSize = ImVec2} to create a dedicated window with an open button

setSectionOpenState.desc: Opens or closes a section by its name (opening an advanced section also opens "Advanced").

getSectionOpenState.desc: Open state of a section (or of "Advanced").

returns.desc: nil if the section is unknown

getSectionWindowName.desc: ImGui window name of a section: "Dynamic Decals Tool - <section.windowName>".

registerToolbarToolItem.desc: Adds an item to the toolbar (tools part), sorted by order.

registerToolbarActionItem.desc: Adds an item to the toolbar (actions part), sorted by order.

registerEditorOnUpdateFn.desc: Registers an update function called every frame by the tool (key = name).

registerOnEditorGuiFn.desc: Registers an additional draw function executed with the editor UI.

onSerialize.desc: Lua reload serialization hook: returns an empty table.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called on vehicle switch: updates the materials (settings.updateMaterials).

getMainScrollY.desc: Current vertical scroll of the main window.

setCurrentMaskEditingLayerUid.desc: Sets the layer whose mask is being edited (nil to leave this mode).

getCurrentMaskEditingLayerUid.desc: Uid of the layer whose mask is being edited, or nil.
